description: Get ONE character sheet in full — every descriptive field plus the three that decide what you can do with it. `prompt_prefix_en` is the text block describing this person; it is what the backend prepends wherever the sheet is used. `reference_images` decides whether the sheet is usable at all: lab_generate REJECTS a character_refs entry without one, before any quota is spent — if it is empty, run lab_generate_character_reference first. `states` carries the state sheets against character drift (costume, light, physical condition); lab_get_character_sheet renders them agent-readable.

character_id.description: Character sheet id (from lab_list_characters) — positive integer as string

preview.description: Attach the reference images themselves, downscaled to 512px. `reference_images` decides whether the sheet is usable at all — seeing them is the check, counting them is not: a sheet can carry a URL to a picture of the wrong person.

name: lab_get_character
title: Get Character
